label: The Making of Polyphonic Archive

blocks.text: The map of how Polyphonic Archive was made — the questions, tensions and craft behind turning a near-silent archive into a podcast. Four regions branch from here: what was absent, how the story was built, how it was translated between media, and the ethics beneath it all.

questions: What does it take to give voice to those the archive left silent?
When the record runs out, what may we honestly add?
